statements.impact_statement: The advisory: ZipStreamReader (src/read/stream.rs) extracts by Local File Header names while ZipArchive trusts the Central Directory; exploitation needs the streaming reader, which nothing here calls. zip 7.2.0 is linked into /usr/bin/meilisearch only through candle-core 0.9.2 (checksum c15b675b80d994b2eadb20a4bbe434eabeb454eac3ee5e2b4cf6f147ee9be091), the sole dependent of zip 7.2.0 in the v1.53.3, v1.55.0 and v1.56.0 Cargo.lock files (meilisearch's own zip 6.0.0 is a build-dependency of crates/meilisearch/build.rs for the mini-dashboard and is not in the binary). candle-core declares zip ^7.2.0 with default-features = false and no features (crates.io dependency table for 0.9.2), so the unified feature set of this copy is empty. candle-core reads archives only with zip::ZipArchive::new plus by-name entry reads (src/npy.rs:286, :308, :383, :411, :425; src/pickle.rs:677, :773) and writes with zip::ZipWriter (src/npy.rs:359). Verified 2026-11-01 on the crates.io 0.9.2 source: grep -rnE 'ZipStreamReader|read_zipfile_from_stream|\.extract|extract_unwrapped' over src returned nothing. No fixed 7.x release exists (fix 9.x); candle-core 0.11.1 still requires zip ^7.2.0.

The advisory: the AES entry reader (src/aes.rs) skips its HMAC check on premature EOF.
